# Drip API Documentation

> Reference for Drip's REST API, JavaScript API, Custom Dynamic Content, Shopper Activity API and MCP server. The REST API is served from https://api.getdrip.com/ and the MCP server from https://api.getdrip.com/mcp. The whole reference is one page at https://developer.drip.com/.

To connect an AI assistant or agent to Drip, use the MCP server: it signs in with OAuth in the browser, and no API key is needed. Call `list_accounts` first; its account ids are the `account_id` argument for the other tools.

## Docs

- [MCP Server](https://developer.drip.com/#mcp-server): server URL, OAuth sign-in, and setup for Claude Code, Claude, Cursor and VS Code
- [Introduction](https://developer.drip.com/#introduction): base URL and request format
- [Authentication](https://developer.drip.com/#authentication): API tokens and OAuth for the REST API
- [Rate Limiting](https://developer.drip.com/#rate-limiting): request limits
- [Errors](https://developer.drip.com/#errors): error responses
- [Subscribers](https://developer.drip.com/#subscribers): create, update and look up subscribers
- [Events](https://developer.drip.com/#events): record custom events
- [Workflows](https://developer.drip.com/#workflows): workflows, triggers and subscribers
- [JS API](https://developer.drip.com/#js-section): the JavaScript API for your website
- [Shopper Activity](https://developer.drip.com/#shopper-activity-section): cart, order and product activity
